acceptance: Use the same saved workflow; change only the two text inputs through normal Wright UI.
Create actual CAD geometry through the connected provider and publish its actual captured image.
The native image-generation request must contain that same capture as an image reference, alongside the supplied rendering description.
Open the actual capture and final image in Wright for each case, including a separate repeat execution.
No customer code, terminal, hidden APIs, configuration repair, developer coaching or intervening workflow correction.
Retain all attempts and continuous customer timing; record developer effort separately.
comparison_policy: Use semantic and provenance checks, not byte-identical generative image comparisons. Images are artistic visualizations, not dimensional or physical-material acceptance.
qualification_scope: Prepared UI use/reuse, three successful executions, not clean installation or fresh natural-language workflow creation. Full laboratory records retained locally.
